judged_text: TopicEmbed.import stores third-party feed/HTML content as a post with cook_method :raw_html and Post#cook returns raw unfiltered, with no sanitize step anywhere in the import path. Arbitrary HTML/JavaScript from a remote RSS feed or imported article is stored as the post body and rendered via `raw post.cooked` in app/views/embed/best.html.erb (and everywhere cooked posts render), letting the feed publisher inject script into pages served on the forum's origin — a stored XSS vector gated only by the admin choosing to enable feed polling.

Arbitrary HTML/JavaScript from a remote RSS feed or imported article is stored as the post body and rendered via `raw post.cooked` in app/views/embed/best.html.erb (and everywhere cooked posts render), letting the feed publisher inject script into pages served on the forum's origin — a stored XSS vector gated only by the admin choosing to enable feed polling.

adjudication.rationale: The diff adds a `:raw_html` cook method (`Post.cook_methods`) and changes `Post#cook` to `return raw` when `cook_method == :raw_html` (app/models/post.rb), bypassing the normal cooking/sanitization pipeline. `TopicEmbed.import` creates posts with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` and `raw: absolutize_urls(url, contents)` (app/models/topic_embed.rb). The feed polling path (`Jobs::PollFeed`) takes `i.content` from the RSS/Atom feed, unescapes it, and passes it straight into `TopicEmbed.import` with no sanitization (app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb). The embed view renders with `<%= raw post.cooked %>` (app/views/embed/best.html.erb), so attacker-controlled HTML/JS from a feed/article can be stored and served from the forum origin, i.e., stored XSS. The `Readability::Document` whitelist only applies to `import_remote`, not the RSS feed import path.
